identity_evidence.quote: The subject of this case report, an 11‐year‐old female

attribution_limitations: Absolute VO2max at T4 is printed as 1.15 L per minute in the text but 1.16 in Table 2; the two printed values are kept as a source conflict (both review_only).

The text says height had increased by 3.2 cm relative to T2, but Table 1 prints 148.3 and 153.0 cm and a 3.2 percent change from T2 to T4; the mismatch is arithmetic only, so the text value is not recorded as a separate item.
The text places CF-related diabetes at 10 years of age while the Figure 1 caption places its diagnosis at 10.9 years; read as a difference in precision of the same age, not two different events.

Table 2 prints dashes for maximal heart rate at T2 and T4, and the footnote states maximal heart rate was available for only two tests because of equipment malfunction; the dash cells are taken as the unavailable tests.
The Table 2 row label for the ventilatory equivalent for oxygen is printed with a misplaced slash; the footnote defines the variable as VE/VO2.
The 64th-to-5th BMI percentile fall over 10 months (Fig. 1) covers a different interval from the Table 1 BMI percentiles at T1 to T4; the two are recorded separately.

Text-stated changes (for example +1.7 cm, +9.2 kg, +0.07 L per minute, a 49% increase in time to exhaustion from T1 to T4) and the discussion target weights for the 50th BMI percentile are author arithmetic on the table values and are not recorded as separate items.

evidence.quote:
Figure 1
Changes in body mass index as measured by percentile in the 3‐year period preceding the procedure and 1 year following. Dashed line at 10.9 years indicates diagnosis of CFRD. Dotted lines at 11.8, 12.1, 12.4, and 13.1 years indicate T1, T2, T3, and T4, respectively. Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy inserted 2 days after T2.

Figure 2
Changes in predicted FEV _(1) (○) (r = −0.64) and absolute VO _(2max) (●) (r = 0.40) over the 15‐month observation window of this case report. Four vertical lines indicate T1–T4. Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy inserted 2 days after T2.

limitations: Caption-layer visual status not_inspected; the two charts are reviewed in the separate visual submission.
Table cells are recorded per time point with times from the column headers and footnote legend; percent-change columns are author-calculated and stored as separate observations.
Absolute VO2max at T4 differs between the text (1.15) and Table 2 (1.16); both values are kept as review_only source-conflict items.
Author-calculated target weights for the 50th BMI percentile and text-stated deltas that repeat table values are not recorded as separate facts.
RPE and RPD ratings are recorded as performance scores in symptoms_function; the 1-10 scale is stated only in the methods.
No allergies, oncology, reproductive, social exposure or medication doses for childhood treatments are documented.

claims.text: An 11-year-old female with cystic fibrosis, confirmed by sweat chloride above 60 mmol/L and homozygosity for the ΔF508 mutation, presented at birth with meconium ileus requiring surgery. Childhood brought Pseudomonal and Staphylococcal chest infections and relapsing allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis treated with antibiotics, mucoactives, corticosteroids, antifungals and physiotherapy, then impaired glucose tolerance at age 9 and CF-related diabetes requiring insulin at 10 years.

During the 15-month period she was unstable and had 22 days of intravenous antibiotics.
